caption: The drawing depicts a single flat shoe positioned at an angle on a plain, pale beige background. The shoe's exterior is dark blue, with a light brown edge around the opening. The interior of the shoe is light beige, showing a textured surface. The front of the shoe is decorated with a zigzag trim and beaded pattern in a muted red or pink shade, which continues around the opening toward the middle of the shoe. The toe area features intricate red or pink ornamental embroidery with symmetrical designs, bordered by fine white outlines. There are no other objects or details in the drawing besides the shoe.
title: Evening Slipper
